name: Solano County Green Valley

known.via: English Wikipedia "Solano County Green Valley AVA"

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A small North Coast valley AVA in Solano County, east of Napa Valley, about one mile wide and four miles long between the Vaca Mountains and the Mount George Range. Solano County is added to the name to tell it apart from Green Valley in Sonoma.
